messages.content: Find a picnic spot in Miami.

function.name: local_fauna
function.description: Get information about fauna in a specified region. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The region or area to find information about.

species_type.description: Type of species e.g birds, mammals etc. for detailed information.

migration_season.description: Season when fauna migrate e.g spring, winter, none. Default is none.

message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to three great picnic spots around Miami—each offers its own vibe, so pick one that matches your mood: | Spot | Location & Highlights | Why It Rocks | |------|-----------------------|--------------| | **South Pointe Park** | *Miami Beach* – right on the southern tip overlooking Biscayne Bay.
• Picnic tables + grills
• Shaded pavilions, playgrounds, bike paths
• Views of cruise ships & dolphins | Perfect blend of beach‑side scenery and family‑friendly facilities. Great for sunset picnics or morning brunches before hitting the boardwalk. | | **Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Recreation Area** | *Key Biscayne* – just north of downtown Key West but accessible via ferry from Miami.
• Historic lighthouse view
• Open lawns, fire pits, BBQ stations
• Dog‑friendly trails | Ideal if you want a quieter escape with historic charm. Bring blankets and enjoy panoramic ocean views while staying close enough to return to Miami city life. | | **Oleta River State Park** | *Northwest Miami* – largest urban park in the U.S.
• Lakeside picnic areas, canoe rentals, nature trails
• Firewood available for campfires
• Bike rental station | Best for active families who love water sports plus a relaxed picnic setting. You’ll get fresh air, scenic river views, and plenty of space for kids to run off. | ### Quick Tips: 1. **Check Hours:** Most parks open early (~7–8 AM) and close late afternoon/early evening depending on season. 2. **Reserve Tables If Needed:** South Pointe often has limited table availability during peak times; call ahead or book online through their website. 3. **Pack Essentials:** Sunscreen, hats, reusable plates/bowls, trash bags, and a cooler full of drinks keep everyone happy—and help preserve the natural beauty! Enjoy your sunny day out in Miami!
message.reasoning:
The user wants a picnic spot in Miami. We can provide suggestions manually; no tool needed.

We should give some popular spots with details like location, amenities, best time, and maybe mention nearby attractions. Also note if there are restrictions (e.g., dog-friendly). Provide at least three options.
